review_candidates.description: Job Description Role Purpose This role sits at the heart of the organization’s digital learning and innovation agenda. The Technology & Digital Production Manager leads the Educational Technology function, overseeing design, creative, technology, data, and multimedia production teams to deliver scalable, high-quality, and sustainable digital learning solutions. The role drives the adoption of artificial intelligence, automation, digital production workflows, and system integrations to improve productivity, enhance learner experiences, and ensure alignment with global technology and innovation standards. Working in a matrix environment, this leader partners closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, Coordinators, and cross-functional squads to ensure technical excellence, consistency, and operational capacity across all solutions. Key Accountabilities Technical Leadership & Operational Excellence Lead the design, creative, development, data, and audiovisual production functions, ensuring delivery capacity, technical quality, and operational efficiency. Define, maintain, and continuously improve technical standards, solution architectures, production processes, and digital learning workflows. Ensure digital learning solutions are technically viable, scalable, integrated, and sustainable within client technology ecosystems. Establish quality assurance standards, testing protocols, monitoring processes, and technical acceptance criteria for all digital solutions. AI, Automation & Innovation Drive the strategic application of artificial intelligence across content creation, production workflows, and operational processes. Define and implement AI agents, prompt engineering standards, automation frameworks, and productivity-enhancing tools. Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve quality, scalability, efficiency, and business value. Lead process automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and enable greater delivery capacity. Systems Integration & Data Management Oversee technical integrations involving APIs, LMS/LXP platforms, data exchanges, and connected learning ecosystems Ensure reliable data governance, information quality, operational reporting, and platform performance. Monitor operational metrics and technology performance indicators to support continuous improvement and decision-making. People Leadership & Stakeholder Management Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for technical managers and specialist teams. Partner with Project Managers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to align technology priorities with project objectives. Act as a trusted advisor on technology, innovation, and digital learning best practices. Maintain alignment with global corporate teams regarding technology standards and innovation initiatives. Candidate Profile Experience & Capability Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Educational Technology, Product Management, or a related discipline. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary technical and creative teams in digital, educational, product, or technology-driven environments. Strong understanding of digital learning solutions, instructional technologies, and production operations. Experience within EdTech, learning consulting, training organizations, or education-focused businesses is highly valued. Technical Strength Knowledge of authoring tools, design software, multimedia production platforms, and LMS/LXP environments. Strong understanding of APIs, systems integration, digital solution development, and the practical application of artificial intelligence. ; Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, and squad-based delivery models. Familiarity with product management concepts such as backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and continuous improvement. Knowledge of analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI, Jira, or Monday.com. Advanced English required. Mindset & Behaviours Performance-oriented leadership style with a strong focus on execution and results. Agile mindset with adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Systems-thinking approach combined with strong attention to technical detail. Proactive, analytical, and innovation-driven professional. Why Join This is an opportunity to shape the future of digital learning and technology-enabled education. You will lead high-impact teams, drive AI and automation transformation initiatives, influence enterprise-wide innovation, and work with global stakeholders to deliver scalable, modern learning solutions that create real business value. About Us GP Strategies Corporation is one of the world's leading talent transformation providers. By delivering award-winning learning and development solutions, we help organizations transform through their people and achieve meaningful change. GP Strategies has delivered our innovative consulting, learning services, and talent technology solutions to over 6,000 organizations globally. From our global experience working across thousands of projects and initiatives over the past 55 years, we've learned that relationships, business, work, innovation, strategy, and transformation are all about people. And, to put it simply, GP Strategies is about our people - an extensive global network of learning experts. Additional information can be found at www.gpstrategies.com . With more than 4000 employees in over 30 countries, diversity at GP Strategies is second nature! Beyond our locations, our culture focuses on performance and revolves around respect, fairness, and working collaboratively to achieve our goals. We support our People, no matter who they are or where they are from, because we all have valuable and unique perspectives and approaches. That's how great ideas are born, which enable us to work smarter. GP Strategies is committed and proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related conditions, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other federally protected class.
